messages:
maya: Heads-up — preflight SLO spot check before the canary shift for release v2.2.0. Asking for 2 eyeballs on p95 and error-rate spikes. @sahil @eva :eyes:
ops-bot: Deploy-bot noticed canary rollout scheduled in 10m. Posting canary config and canary traffic percentage. :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Canary config: route=canary-v2.2.0, pct=5, duration=15m
maya: Thanks. Quick checklist: 1) confirm p95 baseline, 2) watch 5xx and 4xx trends, 3) confirm KV cache warmup. If anything >20% deviation hold and pin.
sahil: Looking at dashboards — linking: https://dash.internal.redwood/slo/project/canary-1767
sahil: p95 baseline ~1.2s, current realtime sparkline -> 1.6s over last 5m. error-rate bumped from 0.15% -> 0.42% (mostly 502).
eva: Hmm 502s likely proxy timeouts? Can anyone correlate to kvcache miss rate? Jamal, any infra signals?
jamal: kvcache miss rate ticked at the same time, +6% on canary nodes after shift started. tracing shows a few backend 503s during GC window.
maya: Good catch. Ops-bot — can you pause the traffic shift and pin to previous version until we triage? Use `deploy-bot pause` and pin to v2.1.9 if pause succeeds.
ops-bot: Received pause request. Running `deploy-bot pause --thread 1767899999`
ops-bot: Pause succeeded. Canary traffic frozen at 5%. Pinning fallback to v2.1.9 now.
ops-bot: Pin complete: all new requests routed to v2.1.9, canary will be rolled back once ops confirm. :white_check_mark:
sahil: Confirmed: p95 trending back to baseline after pin; error-rate declining to 0.18% in last 2m.
eva: I'll trigger a quick GC-friendly deploy on canary nodes and re-run the warmup probe. If GC overlaps again we need a different staging schedule.
jamal: Agree — scheduling GC offset by 10m. Also adding a synthetic probe hitting prefix-cache endpoints every 30s during next run.
maya: Great. Postmortem note for release notes: under "rollout notes" include: hold due to transient kvcache miss + backend GC overlap, pinned to v2.1.9, follow-up scheduled.
eva: I'll update the release-notes draft and add the monitor links. :thumbsup:
sahil: Thanks everyone. Will keep monitoring for 15m then call for a safe retry if signals stay green.
maya: Closing the thread when we hit stable metrics for 15 consecutive minutes. Thanks :pray:
